behavior: Every payment exception shows what happened and the next step on the owner's invoice page and the pay page (PLAN 9.1)
acceptance: Owner page: expired with nothing paid offers New invoice filled with the same client, amount and accepted options; expired partial shows the amount held for the payer and offers a new invoice for the rest; late money shows as held for the payer; a partly paid open invoice gets no extra line (R-77)

Pay page: a partly paid invoice shows the remaining amount with the time left and one line to copy the address from this page, not from wallet history; the API's closed flag makes the owner page, Invoices, Activity and the list filters name a closed checkout expired at the same moment, never one whose on-time money may still complete it (R-77)
notes: 2026-10-14 review fail by independent reviewer: FAIL. (1) Status mismatch at the confirming edge. A partially_paid invoice whose next payment was seen before expiry and is still confirming: the API read says confirming=true, so the owner page and the Invoices pill show Confirming. But StatusFilterSQL (invoice/list.go:27) files it under status=expired and drops it from status=open, and activityStatus (activity/lib/activity.ts:37-41) shows the Activity row as Expired partly paid. It can still become Paid. Reproduced with a scratch Go test (partially_paid + detected transfer with block_time <= expires_at + closeCheckout): read confirming=true, invoices status=open 0 items, status=expired 1 item, activity status=expired returns the invoice. Scratch vitest: invoiceStatus=confirming, activityStatus=expiredPartiallyPaid. Fix: add the confirming condition (detected transfer on option_id with block_time <= expires_at, as in invoice/service.go:33) to the expiry branch of StatusFilterSQL; send confirming on activity invoice rows and pass it to activityStatus the way invoiceStatus does; add a Go and a Vitest case. (2) ledger.go:55 keeps partially_paid when the full amount is booked but the second RPC has not agreed yet. After expiry the web turns that into expiredPartiallyPaid. invoiceException then gives closedPartial with left=0, so the page says '5 USDC is held for the payer. To collect the remaining 0 USDC, send a new invoice', and the button fills the form with 0. The invoice then goes Paid and settles to the merchant, which contradicts the held-for-payer line (D-26). Scratch vitest confirmed {kind: closedPartial, received: 5000000n, left: 0n}. Fix: do not file it as expired when non-late received >= amount (web), and do the same in SQL. Minor: (3) restartFrom (invoices/lib/invoices.ts:200) uses optionLocked. A payer-chooses invoice gets locked by a late-only deposit too (chosen_id comes from the first transfer, late or not; ledger/process.go), so an expired-unpaid one restarts as fixed instead of any. Use received==0 rather than !optionLocked. (4) new-invoice-screen.tsx:39 reads .data. RTK Query keeps the last arg's data after a 404, so use currentData as invoice-detail does. Impact is only a short window during a profile switch. (5) A token that is no longer enabled silently falls back to tokens[0] with the old amount (new-invoice-form token fallback). (6) openapi.yaml StatusFilter description (lines 501-503) and docs/backend/api.md still say open/partially_paid is open. (7) The backend counts block_time <= expires_at as on time, so the web and SQL '<=' call it closed 1 second early. Negligible. (8) Mutations that survive the tests: removing partially_paid from the SQL IN list, dropping !optionLocked in restartFrom, and <= changed to <. Checked OK: privacy (no client in URL; a fresh ?from= with another profile's id gets a 404 and an empty form), USD 1:1 prefill, decimals from the shown option, other-option deposits excluded from the rest amount, toasts/bell/search/PDF/checklist unaffected. Ran: pnpm --filter @forwend/web test 120/120; go test ./internal/... all ok.

2026-10-14 review fail by independent reviewer: Re-review of 002fbd1: FAIL. Earlier findings 1-4, 6, 7 and 8 are fixed. Checked: the confirming flag and ClosedSQL use the same detected-on-time test, so partlyConfirming and closed are never both true; a full on-time amount awaiting the second RPC is not closed; restartFrom uses received==0n and has a late-lock test; the screen uses currentData; openapi and api.md are updated; the boundary now matches the ledger (closed when expires_at < now; on time when block_time <= expires_at). Finding 5 (a disabled token falls back to tokens[0]) is acceptable as is. NEW DEFECT: ClosedSQL (invoice/list.go) only accepts payment_status open or partially_paid. When an open invoice gets a payment after expiry and before chain finality passes expiry, the ledger sets it to detected: status() returns Detected when anyTransfer is true, and late transfers count (ledger.go:67). So closed=false and the views disagree. invoiceStatus and activityStatus show Confirming; the list filter puts it under status=open; the owner page shows Confirming plus the late-held line and no New invoice. That is the R-77 'got money after its checkout closed' case, and acceptance 2 says every view names a closed checkout expired. Reproduced with a scratch ledger sim test (ClosedSQL copied verbatim and diffed identical): late confirmed transfer at expires+10, finality at expires-5 gives payment=detected, refund=held, closed=false, and it becomes expired only after finality passes expiry. A late detected transfer gives payment=detected, closed=false, and it stays detected after finality too, until the transfer confirms. The invoice reads Expired, flips to Confirming when the late money arrives, then flips back to Expired. Fix: allow 'detected' in ClosedSQL's status list. The existing NOT EXISTS (no detected on-time transfer) and the on-time sum < amount already exclude the real detected cases (on-time payment pending; full on-time amount awaiting the RPC). In activityStatus, map closed + detected to expired. Add a TestClosedCheckoutReadsExpired case: open invoice, closed checkout, only a late transfer, status detected. Minor: invoice-detail.tsx:150 still says 'and the status says so', but the pay link and 'Closed on' use the local clock while the pill waits for the API's closed flag (up to REFRESH_MS, 15s). Harmless; update the comment. Ran: pnpm --filter @forwend/web test 121/121; pnpm typecheck ok; go test for invoice, activity, httpapi/... and ledger all ok.

2026-10-14 review pass by independent reviewer: Re-review of 65f2d33: PASS. ClosedSQL (invoice/list.go) now includes detected. The two existing guards still exclude every legitimate detected case: an on-time payment still pending fails NOT EXISTS (the same test as the confirming column), and a full on-time amount awaiting the second RPC fails the on-time sum < amount check. A Detected status from D-27 ordering always has an earlier on-time detected transfer, so it is excluded too. A late transfer, detected or confirmed, has block_time > expires_at, so it trips neither guard and the invoice reads closed. This matches what my earlier ledger sim showed Process produces: payment=detected with only a late transfer. activityStatus maps closed + confirming to expired. closed and the API confirming flag are never both true, so invoiceStatus's partlyConfirming path is unaffected. The owner page now shows Expired, the late-held line and New invoice. Tests can fail: dropping 'detected' from ClosedSQL breaks TestClosedCheckoutReadsExpired invoice 4 (closed true, expired on both lists), and dropping the confirming mapping breaks the new Vitest case. The invoice-detail comment and openapi Invoice.closed are updated. All earlier findings are resolved except 5 (a disabled token falls back to tokens[0]), which is accepted as is. Minor style: one ClosedSQL comment line is longer than the others. Ran: pnpm --filter @forwend/web test 121/121; go test for invoice, activity and httpapi/... all ok.
